question: which five children showed the biggest jump in situp count between the first and second fitness test

which five children showed the biggest jump in situp count between the first and second fitness test
attempts.response:
SELECT 
  "Child ID",
  "Child Name",
  "Gender",
  "Age",
  "Location",
  "Coach",
  "Sit Ups" AS "Baseline Sit Ups",
  "Sit Ups" AS "Endline Sit Ups",
  ("Sit Ups" - L."Sit Ups") AS "Change in Sit Ups"
FROM 
  sportathon_endline
JOIN 
  sportathon_baseline L ON sportathon_endline."Child ID" = L."Child ID"
ORDER BY 
  ("Sit Ups" - L."Sit Ups") DESC
LIMIT 5;
